NONE: › to have a short sleep, especially during the day

example: My cat likes dozing in front of the fire.
我的貓喜歡在火爐前打盹。

NONE: › If you doze off, you start to sleep, especially during the day.

example: The office was so hot I nearly dozed off at my desk.
辦公室裡很熱，我差點在辦公桌上睡著了。
This recipe makes three dozen cookies.
這份配料能做三打曲奇餅。
Could you get me half a dozen (= six) eggs when you go to the supermarket?
你去超市時給我捎半打雞蛋好嗎？
informal I've spoken to him dozens of (= many) times, but I still don't know his name!
雖然我和他說過很多次話，但我連他的名字都還不知道！
The refugees arrived by the dozen/in their dozens (= in large numbers).
難民們成群結隊地到來。

NONE: › informal tired and wanting to sleep
又累又睏的；昏昏欲睡的
› UK informal thinking or reacting slowly

example: Drinking a beer at lunchtime makes me feel dozy all afternoon.
午飯時我喝了一杯啤酒，結果整個下午都昏昏欲睡。
He'd have driven straight into me if I hadn't seen him first - the dozy idiot!
要不是我先看到他，我一定讓他開車撞個正著——這個呆頭呆腦的白癡！
